posts.name: CKBA Membership
posts.cooked:
感谢提问！

关于 GA 决议哪些事项：General Assembly 负责制定协会的整体方向并对其运营行使最终监督权，包括批准预算、批准重大战略决策、接纳新贡献会员，以及选举或罢免董事会成员。

关于 GA 是哪一个「全」：General Assembly 是 CKBA 的最高治理机构，由全体贡献会员组成。它不是 CKB 社区整体，不是 DAO，也不是任何「全 holder」群体。

A New Chapter for CKB: Introducing the Common Knowledge Base Association

The General Assembly is the highest governing body of the Association and consists of all Contributing Members. It is responsible for setting the Association’s overall direction and exercising ultimate oversight of its operations. This includes approving budgets, ratifying major strategic decisions, admitting new Contributing Members, and electing or removing Board members.

posts.cooked:
CKBA Contributing Member — Cycle 1 Outcome

Cycle 1 of the CKBA Contributing Member intake is now complete. Following the vote conducted by the Jun 22 General Assembly, 5 of 13 applicants have been approved as Contributing Members.

A few observations from this cycle to share with future applicants:

What the General Assembly weighed positively:

  • Shipped, verifiable work on CKB with sustained maintenance over time, rather than short-burst contribution
  • Visible presence on Nervos Talk and other public community channels
  • Substantive technical artifacts such as open-source repositories, protocol research, or infrastructure
  • Long-term advocacy combined with platform roles such as channel moderation or community admin

What was harder to evaluate positively:

  • Evidence concentrated on testnet-only or very recent activity, with a limited overall track record
  • Submitted claims that the GA could not independently corroborate from public sources
  • Limited recent activity or declining engagement in the months preceding application
  • Presence concentrated on a single platform (for example X-only) without footprint in CKB community channels

These are descriptive observations, not prescriptive criteria. The GA explicitly chose not to adopt a rigid scoring framework at this stage, and judgment and discussion remain the basis of admission decisions.

All 13 applicants have been emailed individually with the outcome. Approved members will receive onboarding details in a separate follow-up. Applicants not approved this cycle have received a letter with voter feedback synthesized from the GA, and we warmly encourage continued contribution. Several applicants were noted by GA members as candidates whose track record simply needs more time or more visible engagement, not a fundamental change in direction. Reapplication in a future cycle is welcomed.

In keeping with the GA decision on the public member directory, the online identities of contributing members will be published once we have collected each member’s preferences.

Timing of Cycle 2 has not yet been set. Watch this thread for updates.

Thanks to everyone who applied. Cycle 1 was the first time CKBA exercised this process end-to-end, and we have learned a great deal from it.

CKBA Membership

CKBA Contributing Member: Cycle 2 (Q3 2026) Outcome

The General Assembly has completed its vote on the Contributing Member applications received ahead of the October GA. 5 applications were considered, and 1 applicant has been admitted.

Please join us in welcoming Yukang Chen (@chenyukang), a long-standing core developer on CKB and Fiber, as a Contributing Member.

All applicants have been contacted individually with the outcome and a summary of the feedback from GA members.

One observation for future applicants: several applications this round came from builders whose CKB work began recently, and GA members recognised the quality of that work. While the Association is still small, members also gave weight to a longer track record, and a number of them noted that they needed more context to judge applications. Making your work easy to verify, and being visible in community discussions on Nervos Talk and in builder channels, helps the GA assess an application.

Applications remain open on an ongoing basis through the form linked at the top of this thread. Each quarterly General Assembly considers the applications received by the announced cutoff, and the next cutoff will be posted here.

Thanks to everyone who applied.

CKBA Membership
